title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:11690:20130323:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 11690, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) (1) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

(2) Omitted.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Acts) (1) through (649) Omitted.

(650) The Act on the Fostering of the Korea Sea Explorers Association is partially amended as follows:

In Articles 6 and 7, the former part of Article 8, and Articles 9 and 10, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries".

(651) through (710) Omitted.

Article 7 Omitted.
